title: Geometric Tor independence of algebraic spaces
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme and $F,G,H$ be algebraic spaces over $S$, with geometric local rings and canonical stalk maps as in [def-sfb-space-geometric-stalk-models]. For morphisms $f:F\to H$ and $g:G\to H$, say that $f$ and $g$ are geometrically Tor independent if, for every algebraically closed field $\Omega$ in the section universe and every pair of geometric points $x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to F$ and $y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to G$ over $S$ with $f x=g y=t$, one has $\operatorname{Tor}^{\mathcal O_{H,t}}_i(\mathcal O_{F,x},\mathcal O_{G,y})=0$ for every integer $i>0$. The two local rings are modules via the canonical stalk maps, with the common base stalk identified by $f x=g y$; Tor uses projective resolutions [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules].
